name: alchemi
description: Alchemi (Chem-Agent) — an AI agent platform that autonomously designs molecules and synthesis pathways.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/server install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.setup:venv: py -3.13 -m venv venv || py -m venv venv && venv/Scripts/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && venv/Scripts/pip install -r services/ai-engine/requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/server run test && venv/Scripts/python -m pytest services/ai-engine/tests -q
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/server run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
